unit.title: The program and the evaluator write to one stdout stream, and the scorer reads the score from it.
The log path travels to the program in its environment.
A file left in the shared temp directory by one evaluation, or by a process that outlived it, is imported by a later evaluation of another program, problem or framework.
The one evaluator that isolates the program in a child reads the child result with pickle.
A field written by the model is safe in the database and becomes script when a UI renders it.
Script running in a UI page can call the same-origin endpoints that an outside page cannot read: the viewer file endpoints, the manual-mode task list and answer endpoint.
Reachability of the port is the only thing between an outside client and the file-reading handlers.
Whoever answers on the port, or sits on an unverified TLS path, writes every program the operator then runs.
A results or checkpoint directory looks like data and is loaded as code.
Program text and program output are placed in fixed-length code fences in a file an agent is told to load.
Not investigated in run-1 (deferred unit): a .env file in the launch directory overrides the process environment when shinka is imported.
CodeEvolve core: CLI, evolution loop, island processes, LM clients
ShinkaEvolve import-time dotenv loading of <cwd>/.env with override=True
ShinkaEvolve core outside the web UI: database, embeddings, pricing catalog fetch and cache, summarizers, CLI
OpenEvolve core: controller, process_parallel workers, config loading, artifact storage
OpenEvolve CLI agent LLM backends (claude -p, copilot, codex app-server): tool authority of the spawned agent
Benchmark calibration scripts and reference generation
